fields.description: Odessa is an apartment development in Town Square, with one- to three-bedroom homes and advertised three-bedroom duplexes. The developer marks it under construction and publishes a September 2026 site update. Its retrieved plans include a terrace apartment as well as conventional balcony layouts.
amenities: Indoor and outdoor children’s play areas

sources.label: NSHAMA Odessa project and construction update

reviewCoverage.identity: Own Odessa page and named official documents verified; portal Odessa on the Park wording is not treated as another project.
reviewCoverage.location: Own Town Square page and portal identify Dubai. Exact existing Town Square area used; no unverified coordinates or journey times.
reviewCoverage.residences: Official introduction advertises 1–3BR and 3BR duplexes. Eight full numerical drawings inspected, all single-level; 3BR B terrace apartment is not assumed duplex.
reviewCoverage.areas: Every published family in eight-page pack visually read. Total built-up includes balcony/terrace; no internal suite areas substituted for whole-home totals.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Named brochure page 20 visually read; four project-specific amenities adopted. Repeated generic community facilities excluded.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Property Finder body gives historical AED 950,888 versus selected-listing headline AED 1.1m and sold-out label. No official price list/current stock confirmed.
reviewCoverage.payment: Own one-page 45/55 calendar visually read: 10+10+10+5+10 during April 2025–December 2026, then 55% on indicative December 2027 handover.
reviewCoverage.handover: Official payment sheet December 2027 corroborates portal quarter. Current own page under construction with September 2026 update, but no certified percentage or completion document.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official 30-page brochure, eight-page plans and one-page payment retrieved. Repeated brochure plans pooled, total PDF allocation 200. Generic community derivation zero.

overview: Type B is a single-level three-bedroom terrace home; compare total and interior areas separately.
The developer’s construction update establishes the date of its published update, not a certified completion percentage.
research.locationNote: Odessa is within Town Square, Dubai, near its park. No fixed travel-time promise is adopted.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s body quotes AED 950,888; its selected-listing headline is AED 1.1m and also displays sold out. The older figure is a launch reference, not current developer inventory.
research.paymentNote: Original April 2025–December 2027 calendar; confirm a new purchase’s own due dates.
research.handoverNote: December 2027 is indicative on the developer sheet. Own construction update is dated September 2026; no certified percentage is claimed.
